# Lazur, Full product documentation for LLMs
# https://www.lazur.app/llms-full.txt
# Last updated: October 2026

## Overview

Lazur is a context-aware personal AI assistant for macOS. Hold a global hotkey, talk naturally, and get help writing, replying, rewriting, prompting, and completing work in Slack, Gmail, Cursor, VS Code, Notion, Linear, and any other Mac app.

Lazur uses voice as the interface, but the outcome is **finished work**, not only a transcript. It understands the app and screen context already in front of you, so you can say what you need without restating the whole situation. It is not meeting transcription or speaker labeling.

The product category is **context-aware AI assistance**: talk naturally; Lazur handles structure, tone, context, and the next useful action when you ask it to.

## Core features

### Voice input
Hold-to-talk (or toggle) system-wide. Speech is transcribed on the Mac and can become a message, note, prompt, reply, or other finished output. Audio is not uploaded for speech-to-text.

### Local speech-to-text
NVIDIA Parakeet TDT runs on-device. Audio does not leave the Mac during transcription. Lazur does not identify speakers or diarize meetings.

### Cloud polish (optional)
When Polished mode is on, **text** (not audio) is sent to cloud AI to clean filler, punctuation, and layout. Paste happens once, with the polished result.

### AI actions and context
Voice commands to write, rewrite, reply, summarize, or reformat using the front window and selected text. Optional screen glance (Screen Recording permission) helps with requests such as “reply to this.” Pro includes 150 agent messages/month. Power includes 1,000 agent messages/month.

### Personal dictionary and snippets
Names, jargon, and voice-triggered expansions stay local and sync if you choose.

### Zen Mode
On-device noise suppression while you dictate.

### Clipboard slots
Nine clipboard slots for quick paste.

## Pricing

| Plan | Price (USD) | Key features |
|------|-------------|--------------|
| Free trial | 7 days | Full Pro access, no credit card required |
| Pro | $18/mo or $15/mo billed annually | Unlimited talk, 150 agent messages/month |
| Power | $120/mo or $96/mo billed annually | Unlimited talk, 1,000 agent messages/month |

## Platform

- Available: macOS (Apple Silicon)
- Coming soon: Windows

## Permissions required

- Microphone, for voice input
- Accessibility, to paste at the cursor
- Screen Recording (optional), so Intent Mode can glance at the front window

## Privacy model

- Speech-to-text: local (NVIDIA Parakeet on-device). Audio stays on the Mac.
- History: On this Mac by default; Cloud sync is opt-in.
- Polished mode / Intent Mode: text-only cloud processing when those features run.
- Full details: https://www.lazur.app/privacy

## Competitive positioning

| Competitor | Lazur advantage |
|------------|-----------------|
| Wispr Flow | Context-aware polish and Intent Mode; finished writing vs raw transcription |
| Super Whisper | System-wide polish + Intent Mode beyond local STT |
| Willow Voice | Broader rewrite and Intent Mode |
| Apple Dictation | AI polish, personal dictionary, Intent Mode, consistent cross-app paste |
| ChatGPT / general AI | Invisible workflow; pastes where you type |
| MacWhisper | Live cursor dictation, not file or meeting transcription |

## Ideal users

1. **Engineers**, dictate in Cursor/VS Code: TODOs, PR descriptions, prompts, comments
2. **Knowledge workers**, Slack, email, docs without typing
3. **Creators / operators**, high-volume DMs and captions
4. **Students / researchers**, notes and outlines
5. **Privacy-conscious users**, local STT with optional text-only polish

## FAQ

**What is Lazur?**
A context-aware AI work assistant for Mac: hold a hotkey, talk naturally, and get finished writing or useful actions based on what is already on screen. It is not a meeting transcriber.

**How is Lazur different from Wispr Flow?**
Wispr Flow optimizes for fast transcription. Lazur optimizes for finished, context-aware writing and Intent Mode.

**Does Lazur work in Cursor and VS Code?**
Yes. One system-wide hotkey works in all Mac apps, including IDEs.

**Is voice data stored?**
Audio stays on-device (NVIDIA Parakeet). Only text may be sent for polish or Intent Mode when those features run.

**Does Lazur identify speakers?**
No. It is single-speaker dictation into the app you are typing in.

**Is there a free trial?**
Yes. Lazur includes a 7-day Pro trial with no credit card required. After the trial, choose Pro or Power.
